titulo: Europe Today: Blame continues in France, Russia kills two children in Kharkiv
cuerpo: Blame in France over protests continues as Sébastien Lecornu accuses the ultra-left of orchestrating the unrest. In Kharkiv, two children are among the victims of a Russian strike on a park as Putin reportedly floats a summit without Kyiv. And an interview with Ryanair CEO Michael O’Leary.
